title: Fix Admin button infinite loading / connection failure on live site

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the root cause of the Admin button appearing permanently grey and spinning indefinitely on the live production site. The issue originates in the admin role detection logic (useIsCallerAdmin / useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hooks) and/or the actor connection setup (useActor). The fix must ensure that: (a) the actor is fully initialised before the admin check is attempted, (b) any failed or stalled actor connection is detected and surfaced rather than silently hanging, and (c) the admin check resolves to a definitive result (admin / not-admin / error) within a reasonable timeout instead of remaining in a perpetual loading state.

quotes: Der Admin Buttom ist in der Live Web page grau und lädt endlos, das scheint erneut auf Verbingungsprobleme hinzuweisen.

acceptanceCriteria: On the live production site, the Admin button becomes clickable (not grey/disabled) within a few seconds after login for a user with admin privileges.
If the actor connection cannot be established within the timeout window, the Admin button displays a clear error or disabled state with a retry affordance instead of spinning indefinitely.

The useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook always transitions out of its loading phase — it must reach one of: done, timed-out, or error — and never remain stuck in waiting-actor or checking-admin indefinitely.
The fix is verified on the deployed (production) canister, not only in local development.

requirements.text: Harden the actor initialisation in useActor so that connection failures are caught and exposed via a stable error state rather than leaving dependent hooks in a perpetual loading loop. Add a maximum wait threshold so that hooks that depend on the actor (such as admin role checks) can detect an unavailable actor and exit gracefully.

quotes: das scheint erneut auf Verbingungsprobleme hinzuweisen

acceptanceCriteria: useActor exposes an isError / error state when the actor cannot be created within the timeout.
Hooks that gate on actor readiness (useIsCallerAdmin, useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout) react to the actor error state by transitioning to their own error state instead of staying in loading.
No regression: anonymous (unauthenticated) users still see the navigation without the Admin button.

requirements.text: Update the Navigation component to handle the timed-out and error states returned by useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout: when a timeout or connection error occurs, hide the Admin button entirely (rather than showing it in a perpetual grey/loading state) and optionally display a subtle retry trigger.

quotes: Der Admin Buttom ist in der Live Web page grau und lädt endlos

acceptanceCriteria: When useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout reaches the timed-out or error phase, the Admin button is hidden from the navigation bar.
A lightweight retry mechanism (e.g., a small icon button or re-checking on next user interaction) is available so the admin can attempt to reconnect without a full page reload.
The loading spinner/grey state is only shown during the bounded waiting period, not indefinitely.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths — implement fixes in wrapper hooks or separate utility modules instead.
All changes must be compatible with the existing Internet Identity authentication flow.
Backend Motoko code must not be changed unless a backend-side root cause is confirmed.
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall navigation layout or adding new navigation items.
Changes to NFT, collection, or blog functionality.
